name: Mukhyamantri Nahri Kendra
benefit:
> **Monetary Benefit**

- 50% of the project cost or ₹5,00,000, whichever is less, provided as subsidy.
- The remaining 50% of the project cost is provided as a loan.

> ***Subsidy Disbursement***

- Given in two installments – 60% in the first installment and 40% in the second installment.

> ***Interest Rate***

- Loan at 4% per annum.

> ***Repayment***

- Loan (excluding subsidy) must be repai
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a woman. - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. - The applicant must be residing in a tribal area. - The applicant must be engaged in or willing to establish a self-employment venture through a Nahri Kendra.
